events.hook: America's witch capital turns the whole town into one long Halloween party.
events.overview: Salem runs a month-long Halloween celebration with parades, costume events, ghost tours, psychic fairs and haunted houses. It is set among 17th-century history and the Witch Trials story. Peak weekends are packed, so plan around them and book early.
events.costNotes: Lodging is at its yearly peak in October; staying in nearby Boston or Beverly cuts costs.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sleepy Hollow, United States","event":"Great Jack O'Lantern Blaze","note":"Thousands of hand-carved pumpkins along the Hudson River, running through October."},{"destination":"New Orleans, United States","event":"Halloween season and Krewe of Boo","note":"Gothic city with parades, ghost tours and costume-heavy nightlife."}]

events.event: International White Truffle Fair of Alba
events.hook: Shaved white truffles, Barolo, and misty Piedmont hills in peak harvest season.
events.overview: Alba's truffle fair has a market of rare white truffles, tastings, cooking demos and a historic medieval-style Palio. Surrounding Langhe vineyards are in harvest colour, and wine cellars and agriturismi are open for visits. It is the top food trip in Italy this month.
events.costNotes: Truffle dishes and Barolo tastings push food spend above the Italian average.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"San Miniato, Italy","event":"San Miniato White Truffle Festival","note":"Tuscan hilltop alternative with truffle markets, usually from November, so check the dates."},{"destination":"Istria, Croatia","event":"Truffle season and Motovun events","note":"Cheaper truffle hunts and wine in autumn woods."}]

events.hook: Nine days of fire-walking, street processions and incredible vegetarian food.
events.overview: The Chinese-Thai Nine Emperor Gods festival fills Phuket Town with white-clad devotees, firecrackers and entranced mediums in dramatic processions. Shrines serve free vegetarian street food around the clock. Dates follow the lunar calendar, so confirm locally.
events.costNotes: Low-season Thai prices keep lodging and food cheap.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Penang, Malaysia","event":"Nine Emperor Gods Festival","note":"Same lunar-month observance, with temple rituals and a harbour send-off."},{"destination":"Bangkok, Thailand","event":"Jek Gin Jay vegetarian festival, Yaowarat","note":"Yellow-flagged vegetarian food streets in Chinatown."}]

events.hook: A whole city of art-installation pandals, drums and goddess worship.
events.overview: Durga Puja is Kolkata's biggest festival, with elaborate themed pandals, idols, and nightly pandal-hopping crowds. It peaks on Saptami to Dashami, ending with the immersion processions to the Hooghly. UNESCO lists it as intangible cultural heritage.
events.costNotes: Hotel rates spike during the puja, so book early; food and transport remain cheap.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Mysuru, India","event":"Mysore Dasara","note":"Royal palace illuminations and a grand Vijayadashami procession."},{"destination":"Kullu, India","event":"Kullu Dussehra","note":"Himalayan deity procession beginning on Vijayadashami, a lesser-known alternative."}]

events.hook: The world's largest purple-clad religious procession fills Lima's streets.
events.overview: Hundreds of thousands of devotees in purple carry the colonial image of Christ through central Lima on a sea of incense and music. Food stalls serve turrón de Doña Pepa, the seasonal nougat sweet. Processions occur on several October dates; verify the days locally.
events.costNotes: Lima's world-class restaurant scene can raise food spend if you want it to.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Cusco, Peru","event":"Lord of the Earthquakes celebrations","note":"A Holy Week-style procession of its own, in the Inca capital, though dates are mostly in spring."},{"destination":"Arequipa, Peru","event":"Spring-season gastronomy and city tours","note":"A white-stone colonial city with canyon day trips and excellent picanterías."}]

events.hook: Twice a year the sun lights up the statues deep inside Ramses II's temple.
events.overview: On October 22, sunrise light reaches the inner sanctuary of the Great Temple of Abu Simbel and illuminates the statues of Ramses II and the gods. Local festivities and music accompany it. It pairs well with a Nile trip through Aswan and Luxor.
events.costNotes: Aswan-based tours and a private convoy to Abu Simbel add to the activity costs.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Luxor, Egypt","event":"Opet-season temple and West Bank touring","note":"Cooler autumn weather suits Karnak and the Valley of the Kings."},{"destination":"Masai Mara, Kenya","event":"Late wildebeest migration season","note":"Crossings thin out by late October, but the Mara is still strong for game."}]

events.event: Jidai Matsuri and Kurama Fire Festival
events.hook: A 2,000-person costume parade by day and torch-bearing villagers by night.
events.overview: On October 22 Kyoto holds Jidai Matsuri, a procession through the ages in historical costumes from the Heian era onward. That evening, the village of Kurama in the hills lights huge torches for the Kurama no Hi Matsuri. Early autumn colour begins in the surrounding hills.
events.costNotes: Kyoto hotels are expensive in autumn; Osaka makes a cheaper base.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Takayama, Japan","event":"Autumn Takayama Matsuri","note":"Held in early October, so likely over, but the old town is still lovely for autumn colour."},{"destination":"Kishiwada, Japan","event":"Danjiri Matsuri","note":"Cart-racing festival near Osaka; dates vary, so check them."}]

events.hook: A free, huge outdoor sculpture show along the Bondi to Tamarama cliff walk.
events.overview: More than 100 artworks from around the world are set on the cliffs and rock pools of Sydney's coast. It is the world's largest free outdoor sculpture exhibition, and spring weather suits the walk. Pair it with ferries, beaches and the Sydney Harbour waterfront.
events.costNotes: Sydney lodging is pricey; Manly or inner-west suburbs help.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Grafton, Australia","event":"Jacaranda Festival","note":"Purple jacaranda blooms in a small riverside city; usually late October into November."},{"destination":"Phillip Island, Australia","event":"MotoGP Australian Grand Prix","note":"Check the 2026 calendar; the track and penguin parade make a good combined trip."}]

events.event: Banks of the Foyle Halloween Carnival
events.hook: Europe's biggest Halloween street party in a walled city on the Foyle.
events.overview: Derry's Halloween festival has a parade, fireworks over the river, street performers and costume events within its intact 17th-century walls. The Celtic Samhain tradition is strong here, and the city is a good base for the Causeway Coastal Route. Dates are estimated, so confirm before booking.
events.costNotes: Flying to Dublin or Belfast and taking a bus or train is the usual route.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Dublin, Ireland","event":"Bram Stoker Festival","note":"Gothic and literary events in Dublin around the Halloween weekend."},{"destination":"Edinburgh, United Kingdom","event":"Samhuinn Fire Festival","note":"Fire-led Celtic festival on Calton Hill on October 31."}]

events.hook: The race that stops a nation: fascinators, champagne and a 3,200m thoroughbred showdown at Flemington.
events.overview: Cup Day on the first Tuesday of November is a public holiday in Melbourne, with a week of racing, fashion and long lunches around it. Spring in Victoria also means laneway cafes, wine regions and the Great Ocean Road.
events.costNotes: Long-haul fare, and Cup Week accommodation carries a premium.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Christchurch, New Zealand","event":"NZ Cup and Show Week (approx. Nov 10-14)","note":"A smaller, friendlier spring racing week with a country-fair feel."},{"destination":"Fiji","event":"Diwali celebrations (Nov 8)","note":"Large Indo-Fijian festival of lights on a tropical island."}]

events.hook: Marigold altars, cemetery vigils and comparsa parades in Mexico's most atmospheric Day of the Dead.
events.overview: Oaxaca fills with altars, sand tapestries, costumed comparsas and candlelit graveyard vigils in nearby villages. Mezcal, mole and pan de muerto add to the mood. It is one of the most meaningful cultural events of the year.
events.costNotes: Accommodation prices jump by about 50% over the holiday, so book months ahead.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Pátzcuaro, Mexico","event":"Noche de Muertos on Lake Pátzcuaro","note":"Candlelit island cemetery vigil at Janitzio."},{"destination":"Mexico City, Mexico","event":"Day of the Dead parade and ofrendas","note":"Large parade and altar displays, easy to reach from LAX."}]

events.hook: Over 50,000 runners and millions of spectators across all five boroughs.
events.overview: The world's largest marathon runs from Staten Island to Central Park on the first Sunday of November. Run it or just cheer from Brooklyn or First Avenue. Either way, it is New York at its most electric in peak fall color.
events.costNotes: Marathon-week hotel and rental prices spike, and NYC dining is pricey.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Athens, Greece","event":"Athens Authentic Marathon (early-mid Nov, dates approximate)","note":"Run the original course from Marathon to the Panathenaic Stadium."},{"destination":"Las Vegas, USA","event":"Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix (approx. Nov 19-21)","note":"Night race down the Strip if you want spectacle over mileage."}]

events.hook: Torch-lit marching societies, burning effigies and fireworks in England's wildest bonfire night.
events.overview: Thousands of costumed bonfire society members parade through the narrow streets of this Sussex town with flaming torches, barrels and tableaux. The tradition goes back centuries and is gloriously unpolished. Visitors must plan around road closures and an early-evening start.
events.costNotes: Base nearby in Brighton or London and use the train; Lewes lodging fills up quickly.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Ottery St Mary, England","event":"Tar Barrels (Nov 5)","note":"Locals run through the streets carrying flaming barrels."},{"destination":"Bridgwater, England","event":"Bridgwater Guy Fawkes Carnival (approx. Nov 7)","note":"England's largest illuminated carnival, with the Squibbing finale."}]

events.hook: The Pink City glows with millions of lights, lamps and fireworks over its bazaars and palaces.
events.overview: Diwali is India's biggest festival, and Jaipur lights up its old-city markets, havelis and forts in a famously photogenic display. Expect sweets, rangoli, family gatherings and fireworks. The markets are at their busiest and most beautiful during the festival days.
events.costNotes: Flights are the main cost; India on the ground is very affordable.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Amritsar, India","event":"Bandi Chhor Divas at the Golden Temple (Nov 8)","note":"The Golden Temple is illuminated and reflected in the sacred pool."},{"destination":"Varanasi, India","event":"Dev Deepawali (approx. Nov 24)","note":"Millions of oil lamps line the Ganges ghats."}]

events.hook: Dhow races, donkey races and Swahili poetry on a car-free UNESCO island.
events.overview: This lesser-known festival celebrates Swahili heritage on Lamu Old Town, a UNESCO site with no cars. It includes traditional dhow sailing races, henna painting, Swahili dance and music, and craft displays. The pace is slow and the setting is beautiful.
events.costNotes: Includes a connection via Nairobi and a domestic flight to Lamu; exact festival dates are confirmed late.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Zanzibar, Tanzania","event":"Stone Town and dhow culture","note":"Similar Swahili coast heritage with more infrastructure."},{"destination":"Marrakech, Morocco","event":"Marrakech International Film Festival (late Nov/early Dec, dates TBC)","note":"A cultural draw in a very different part of Africa."}]

events.hook: Thousands of camels, desert musicians and a sacred lake bathing ritual in Rajasthan.
events.overview: Herders, traders and pilgrims gather in the Thar Desert town for camel trading, folk performances, turban-tying contests and sunset sand dunes. It peaks at Kartik Purnima, when pilgrims bathe in the holy lake. The event is raw, colorful and photogenic.
events.costNotes: Fair-week tent camps and guesthouses book out; the fair's official program dates shift each year.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sonepur, India","event":"Sonepur Mela (from Kartik Purnima)","note":"Asia's largest cattle and animal fair, far from the tourist trail."},{"destination":"Varanasi, India","event":"Dev Deepawali (approx. Nov 24)","note":"Same full moon, with a river of lamps on the Ganges."}]

events.event: Loy Krathong and Yi Peng Lantern Festival
events.hook: Thousands of glowing lanterns rise into the night sky as floating krathongs drift down the river.
events.overview: Under the November full moon, Chiang Mai celebrates Lanna-style Yi Peng and Thailand's Loy Krathong together. Residents and visitors release paper lanterns and float candlelit baskets on the Ping River, with parades and temple ceremonies around town. Some of the large organized lantern releases are ticketed events.
events.costNotes: Cheap on the ground, but festival-week lodging rises and mass lantern releases require paid tickets.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sukhothai, Thailand","event":"Loy Krathong at the Historical Park","note":"The festival's traditional setting among ancient ruins."},{"destination":"Hoi An, Vietnam","event":"Full Moon Lantern Festival (Nov 24)","note":"The old town goes car-free with silk lanterns on the river."}]

events.hook: France's oldest Christmas market, in a half-timbered Alsatian city lit up around a giant tree.
events.overview: Strasbourg has hosted its Christmas market since 1570, and it sprawls across a dozen squares under the cathedral's spire. Expect vin chaud, tarte flambée, bredele cookies and craft stalls. It is among Europe's most atmospheric holiday markets, and it opens at the very end of November.
events.costNotes: Peak-season accommodation, and flights to Paris, Frankfurt or Basel plus a train.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Nuremberg, Germany","event":"Christkindlesmarkt (opens approx. Nov 27)","note":"Germany's most famous Christmas market, with gingerbread and a Christkind opening."},{"destination":"Vienna, Austria","event":"Vienna Christmas markets (from mid-Nov)","note":"Opens earlier than most, with grand Rathausplatz and palace markets."}]

events.hook: Nagaland's 17 tribes gather at Kisama Heritage Village for ten days of war dances, rock music and fiery Naga chili.
events.overview: Known as the 'Festival of Festivals', Hornbill brings the Naga tribes together in traditional dress, with log-drum rituals, folk songs, indigenous games and a night bazaar. Evening rock concerts and the Naga Chili Eating Contest round out the programme. It is one of Northeast India's most immersive cultural events and is still little visited by Western travelers.
events.costNotes: Includes an Indian e-visa, Inner Line Permit, festival entry and shared taxis, with homestays and guesthouses for lodging.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Chichibu, Japan","event":"Chichibu Night Festival (Dec 2-3)","note":"Ornate floats, lanterns and fireworks in a mountain town, easy to reach from Tokyo."},{"destination":"Kutch, India","event":"Rann Utsav","note":"A tent city on the white salt desert with folk music and crafts, running through the winter."}]

events.hook: An entire city becomes a canvas of light installations, and the bouchons keep you fed in between.
events.overview: Lyon's Festival of Lights began as a 1852 thank-you to the Virgin Mary and now draws millions to see projections on façades, hillside installations and the Place des Terreaux. Combine it with Lyon's bouchon dining and the nearby Beaujolais wine villages. Hotels sell out early, so lock in lodging soon.
events.costNotes: Festival weekend lodging is at a premium, and the festival itself is free.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Strasbourg, France","event":"Christkindelsmärik Christmas market","note":"One of Europe's oldest Christmas markets, in a half-timbered old town."},{"destination":"Vienna, Austria","event":"Christkindlmarkt season","note":"Rathausplatz markets, Advent concerts and imperial-era cafés."}]

events.event: Feast of Our Lady of Guadalupe
events.hook: Millions of pilgrims arrive at the Basilica of Guadalupe on foot, on bikes and on their knees, with mariachi all night.
events.overview: The feast on Dec 12 is one of the largest Catholic pilgrimages in the world. Pilgrims from across Mexico flood the Basilica with dancers, singers and flower offerings, and the Mañanitas serenade runs at dawn. Pair it with Mexico City's food scene, museums and Christmas lights.
events.costNotes: Short, cheap flight from LAX, and CDMX is excellent value for lodging and food.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"San Miguel de Allende, Mexico","event":"Las Posadas (Dec 16-24)","note":"Candlelit neighborhood processions, piñatas and folk songs."},{"destination":"Antigua, Guatemala","event":"Quema del Diablo (Dec 7)","note":"Bonfires burn effigies of the devil to cleanse the new season, in a colonial setting."}]

events.hook: The year's best meteor shower falls over one of the darkest skies on Earth.
events.overview: The Geminids typically produce up to about 100 meteors an hour at peak, and a waxing crescent moon in 2026 sets early, leaving dark skies for most of the night. NamibRand is an International Dark Sky Reserve, and its dunes and desert-lodge star decks make the show spectacular. Combine it with Sossusvlei at sunrise.
events.costNotes: Costs include a 4x4 rental, park fees and a few lodge nights, and flights go via Johannesburg or Europe.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"San Pedro de Atacama, Chile","event":"Geminids over the Atacama","note":"Very dry, high-altitude skies with excellent observatory tours."},{"destination":"Mauna Kea, Hawaii, USA","event":"Geminids stargazing","note":"A short flight from LAX, with high-altitude viewing above the clouds."}]

events.hook: The African diaspora comes home for beach parties, Afrobeats and highlife concerts and a city that doesn't sleep.
events.overview: Detty December is Accra's holiday season of concerts, beach parties, art shows and food markets, with big Afrobeats and amapiano headliners. Events cluster around Christmas and New Year's, with the biggest festivals in the last week of the month. It is a high-energy way to see Ghanaian music, fashion and jollof firsthand.
events.costNotes: Lodging and flights spike during the diaspora rush, and event tickets are extra.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Lagos, Nigeria","event":"Detty December concerts","note":"A huge Afrobeats scene with big shows through the holidays."},{"destination":"Cape Town, South Africa","event":"Kirstenbosch Summer Sunset Concerts","note":"Picnic concerts on the mountain lawns through the summer season."}]

events.event: Harbin Ice and Snow World opening
events.hook: Life-size ice castles glow in neon at minus 20 degrees Celsius.
events.overview: Harbin's Ice and Snow World builds a city of huge ice towers, slides and palaces from blocks cut from the Songhua River, lit up at night. The official festival runs into January, and the park opens in late December. Add the Sun Island Snow Expo, Russian-style architecture and hot pot to warm up.
events.costNotes: Includes park tickets, a visa-free or transit option where eligible, and a cold-weather gear buffer.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sapporo, Japan","event":"Sapporo White Illumination","note":"Illuminated Odori Park through Christmas, ahead of the Snow Festival in February."},{"destination":"Rovaniemi, Finland","event":"Santa Claus Village and aurora season","note":"A Christmas-themed experience with Northern Lights chances."}]

events.event: Noche de Rábanos (Night of the Radishes)
events.hook: Artisans carve giant radishes into nativity scenes and Oaxacan legends in the zócalo.
events.overview: Since 1897, Oaxaca has celebrated a single night of competitive radish carving, with giant, grown-for-the-purpose radishes shaped into intricate dioramas. Crowds queue for hours along the Zócalo, and the mezcal, mole and Christmas calendas (parades) continue all week. It is a quirky tradition that few travelers outside Mexico have heard of.
events.costNotes: Holiday flights to Oaxaca typically route via Mexico City, and lodging is pricier during Christmas week.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Santa Fe, USA","event":"Canyon Road Farolito Walk (Dec 24)","note":"Thousands of paper lanterns line the historic streets on Christmas Eve."},{"destination":"Villa de Leyva, Colombia","event":"Día de las Velitas (Dec 7-8)","note":"Thousands of candles light the colonial town square."}]

events.hook: Over a hundred yachts race out of Sydney Harbour on Boxing Day, bound for Tasmania.
events.overview: One of the world's great offshore races starts on Boxing Day, with spectator boats, headland crowds and a harbour full of sails. Use summer Sydney as a base for beaches and fireworks, then fly to Hobart to watch the fleet arrive at Constitution Dock. It is both a major sporting event and a very Australian holiday.
events.costNotes: Peak summer holiday pricing, with a domestic flight to Hobart included in the activity budget.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Hobart, Australia","event":"Taste of Tasmania (Dec 28 - Jan 3)","note":"A waterfront food festival and the finish of the yacht race."},{"destination":"Gisborne, New Zealand","event":"Rhythm and Vines (Dec 29-31)","note":"A beachy New Year's Eve festival where NZ sees the sun first."}]

events.hook: Two million people in white welcome the New Year on Copacabana Beach, with fireworks and offerings to Iemanjá.
events.overview: Rio's New Year's Eve combines a free beachside concert series, a famous fireworks show over the Atlantic and Afro-Brazilian traditions like flowers and candles for the sea goddess Iemanjá. Wear white, jump seven waves and stay for the summer beach days afterward. Book lodging far in advance, as the best areas sell out.
events.costNotes: New Year's lodging has a big price premium, and the beach party itself is free.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Salvador, Brazil","event":"Réveillon and Festa da Boa Viagem","note":"Afro-Brazilian music, beaches and a street party in the historic Pelourinho."},{"destination":"Valparaíso, Chile","event":"New Year's Eve fireworks over the bay","note":"One of South America's biggest fireworks shows, set on colorful hillsides."}]

events.hook: Torchlight procession, a castle-backed street party and a cèilidh to ring in the New Year.
events.overview: Hogmanay is Scotland's New Year festival, with a torchlight procession, concerts, a huge fireworks display over the castle and the singing of 'Auld Lang Syne' among thousands. Day trips to the Highlands and whisky distilleries round out the trip. Tickets for the Street Party and Concert in the Gardens sell out well in advance.
events.costNotes: NYE lodging in Edinburgh is very expensive, and event tickets are included in the activities figure.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Reykjavik, Iceland","event":"New Year's Eve bonfires and fireworks","note":"The whole city sets off fireworks, with a chance of aurora."},{"destination":"Prague, Czechia","event":"New Year's Eve over Charles Bridge","note":"Fireworks above Old Town with cheaper lodging than Edinburgh."}]

events.event: Kaapse Klopse (Cape Town Minstrel Carnival, Tweede Nuwe Jaar)
events.eventDates: Jan 2 (street parade; troupe competitions run through January)
events.hook: Thousands of troupes in sequins and satin banjo-strut through the Cape on the day after New Year.
events.overview: The Kaapse Klopse traces back to the Cape's emancipated slave communities. Troupes in bright satin suits and painted faces parade through the city with brass, banjos and choirs, and the competitions continue at stadiums through January. It is a locally rooted celebration that falls in peak Cape summer, so you can add beaches and winelands.
events.costNotes: Peak summer pricing for flights and stays; food and activities are cheap by US standards.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Salvador, Brazil","event":"Lavagem do Bonfim and Bahia summer street festivals","note":"The Bonfim washing ritual is held in mid-January, with Afro-Brazilian music and processions."},{"destination":"Zanzibar, Tanzania","event":"Mapinduzi Day and Revolution celebrations (Jan 12)","note":"Beach season plus Stone Town cultural events and taarab music."}]

events.hook: Fifteen days of elite sumo at Ryogoku Kokugikan, opening the year's six-tournament calendar.
events.overview: The Hatsu Basho is the first Grand Sumo Tournament of the year, held at Tokyo's Ryogoku Kokugikan. Wrestlers compete daily for the Emperor's Cup, with the best bouts in the late afternoon. Pair it with New Year shrine visits, winter illuminations and Tokyo's food scene.
events.costNotes: Tickets sell out for weekends, so book as soon as they go on sale; flights are the main variable.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kyoto, Japan","event":"Toka Ebisu and winter temple illuminations","note":"Quieter, traditional Japan with a strong food scene."},{"destination":"Seoul, South Korea","event":"Hwacheon Sancheoneo Ice Festival","note":"Ice fishing and winter fun a short trip from Seoul, usually in mid-January."}]

events.event: Magh Mela and Makar Sankranti Holy Dips
events.eventDates: From Makar Sankranti (~Jan 14) through about mid-Feb
events.hook: A tent city on the Ganga-Yamuna confluence where pilgrims bathe at dawn.
events.overview: Every January, millions of pilgrims, sadhus and ascetics camp at the Triveni Sangam in Prayagraj for the Magh Mela. The first major bathing day falls on Makar Sankranti, with more bathing days over the following weeks. It is a more manageable version of the Kumbh Mela, with devotional music, camps and boat rides at sunrise.
events.costNotes: Tent and camp stays are inexpensive; flights to Delhi plus domestic connections drive the cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Ahmedabad, India","event":"International Kite Festival (Uttarayan, Jan 14)","note":"The sky fills with kites in Gujarat on Makar Sankranti."},{"destination":"Madurai, India","event":"Pongal and Jallikattu bull-taming events","note":"A Tamil harvest festival in mid-January with temple celebrations."}]

events.event: Fiestas de la Calle San Sebastián
events.hook: Four nights of salsa, plena, giant-head costumes and street crafts in Old San Juan.
events.overview: The Calle San Sebastián festival closes Puerto Rico's long holiday season with a street party in Old San Juan. Expect live bands, plena and bomba, vejigante costumes, artisan stalls and thousands of revelers moving through the blue-cobbled streets. Pair it with El Yunque and nearby beaches.
events.costNotes: Old San Juan stays spike during the festival; no passport is needed for US citizens.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Panama City, Panama","event":"Summer dry season and Panama Jazz Festival","note":"The jazz festival is typically in January, with good weather in Casco Viejo."},{"destination":"Cartagena, Colombia","event":"Dry-season street festivals and Hay Festival Cartagena","note":"Literary festival with Caribbean heat; usually late January or early February."}]

events.hook: Replica Arks of the Covenant are paraded to Fasilides' Bath, where crowds in white are sprinkled with holy water.
events.overview: Timkat is Ethiopia's most colorful religious festival. Priests carry tabots, replicas of the Ark of the Covenant, in procession, and on the second day the water at Fasilides' Bath in Gondar is blessed and splashed over the crowd. Pair it with Lalibela's rock churches and the Simien Mountains.
events.costNotes: Flights to Addis are the main cost; domestic flights and guides add to activities.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Lalibela, Ethiopia","event":"Timkat in the rock-hewn churches","note":"Smaller crowds than Gondar and an unusual setting."},{"destination":"Jerusalem, Israel","event":"Orthodox Epiphany and Christmas observances","note":"Historic pilgrimages and processions in the Old City in early-to-mid January."}]

events.hook: The Grand Slam of the Asia-Pacific, played in the Melbourne summer heat.
events.overview: The first Grand Slam of the year takes over Melbourne Park for two weeks, with night sessions on Rod Laver Arena and a festival atmosphere around the grounds. Grounds passes give access to dozens of matches, and the city has strong food, laneway bars and nearby wine regions.
events.costNotes: Peak summer and tournament demand push up stays; show-court tickets are the main extra.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sydney, Australia","event":"Sydney Festival and Australia Day (Jan 26)","note":"Summer arts program and harbor celebrations."},{"destination":"Hobart, Tasmania","event":"Taste of Tasmania and Sydney to Hobart finish celebrations","note":"Food-focused summer festival on the waterfront, usually late December to early January."}]

events.hook: The Streif downhill is the most feared ski course in the world, and the town turns into a giant party.
events.overview: The Hahnenkamm weekend brings the World Cup's marquee downhill, super-G and slalom to Kitzbühel. Skiers hit 140 km/h on the Streif while tens of thousands watch from the finish area. The medieval town and its after-race parties are famous in their own right, and you can ski there on the other days.
events.costNotes: Race-week accommodation is very expensive; staying in nearby towns will cut costs.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Wengen, Switzerland","event":"Lauberhorn World Cup Races","note":"Classic ski racing in the Bernese Oberland, usually mid-January."},{"destination":"Chamonix, France","event":"Winter mountain season and World Cup events","note":"Big alpine terrain and a lively town."}]

events.hook: Nearly a thousand torch-bearing 'Vikings' burn a full-size longship in the middle of a Shetland winter.
events.overview: Up Helly Aa is Europe's largest fire festival, with a torchlit procession ending in a galley set alight in Lerwick. The 'Guizer Jarl' and his squad dress as Vikings, and the night continues in halls with performances and drinking. Visitor tickets for the halls are limited, and Shetland's coast and wildlife add days of exploring.
events.costNotes: Flights to Edinburgh or Glasgow plus Sumburgh connection; rooms in Lerwick are scarce and pricey.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Tromsø, Norway","event":"Northern Lights and Tromsø Sami cultural events","note":"Aurora season with polar-night scenery in January."},{"destination":"Reykjavik, Iceland","event":"Þorrablót midwinter feasts and aurora season","note":"Traditional midwinter food festivals begin in late January, with an Icelandic landscape trip."}]

events.hook: Snow sculptures, night parades and Bonhomme, the carnival's snowman mascot, in the old walled city.
events.overview: Quebec's Winter Carnival is among the biggest winter festivals in the world. It includes ice sculpture, night parades, ice-canoe races, snow baths and the Bonhomme character. The walled Old Town makes a good backdrop, and the Château Frontenac and Montmorency Falls add to the winter feel.
events.costNotes: Stays at the opening weekend are higher; choose a weekday if you want savings.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Ottawa, Canada","event":"Winterlude and Rideau Canal Skateway","note":"The world's largest naturally frozen skating rink; usually early February."},{"destination":"Banff, Canada","event":"Ice Magic Festival at Lake Louise","note":"Ice carving championships in the Rockies, usually mid-to-late January."}]

events.event: Monarch Butterfly Peak Season at the Michoacán Biosphere Reserve
events.hook: Millions of monarchs blanket the oyamel firs, and the sound of their wings is unforgettable.
events.overview: Monarchs that migrated from Canada and the US cluster in the mountain forests of Michoacán, and by February they are at their densest. Warm midday hours send them in orange clouds across the sanctuary trails at El Rosario and Sierra Chincua. It is a quiet, little-known natural spectacle within easy reach of Mexico City.
events.costNotes: Fly to Mexico City and add a ground transfer and guided sanctuary entries; cheap on the ground.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Pacific Grove, USA","event":"Monarch overwintering groves","note":"A smaller but drivable version of the migration on the California coast."},{"destination":"Samaná, Dominican Republic","event":"Humpback whale season","note":"Thousands of humpbacks gather in Samaná Bay from January to March."}]

events.hook: Hundreds of thousands of wildebeest calves are born on the southern plains, with predators close behind.
events.overview: February is the peak of calving in the Ndutu area of the southern Serengeti, when around 8,000 calves are born each day. Lions, cheetahs and hyenas follow the herds, so the action never lets up. It is dry-season safari at its best, with fewer vehicles than the July river crossings.
events.costNotes: Park fees and a safari vehicle drive the activity cost; lodges are mid-range tented camps.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Maasai Mara, Kenya","event":"Big cat and resident wildlife season","note":"Lions and cheetahs are easy to see in the dry months."},{"destination":"Okavango Delta, Botswana","event":"Green-season birding and predator action","note":"Fewer visitors, lush landscapes and strong wildlife viewing."}]

events.hook: Building-sized snow sculptures glow across Odori Park in the Hokkaido winter.
events.overview: Every February, Sapporo fills Odori Park with enormous snow and ice sculptures, lit up at night. Pair it with powder skiing at Niseko, steaming ramen and Susukino's izakayas. Hotels fill early, so book far in advance.
events.costNotes: Peak-week hotel rates in Sapporo; add ski day passes if you head to Niseko.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Harbin, China","event":"Harbin Ice and Snow World","note":"Giant illuminated ice castles in deep cold."},{"destination":"Quebec City, Canada","event":"Quebec Winter Carnival","note":"A North American snow festival with ice palaces and the Bonhomme mascot, running to mid-February."}]

events.hook: Africa's carnival capital in miniature, with morna melodies and Brazilian-style samba.
events.overview: Mindelo's carnival draws on Creole, Portuguese and Brazilian traditions, with feathered dancers, Mandingas groups and Cesária Évora's music still in the air. The Tuesday parade is the highlight. It is a small island with a lively music scene and far fewer tourists than Rio.
events.costNotes: Flights usually connect via Lisbon; guesthouses book out during Carnival week.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Barranquilla, Colombia","event":"Carnaval de Barranquilla (Feb 6-9)","note":"UNESCO-listed Caribbean carnival with cumbia and giant parades."},{"destination":"Santiago de Cuba, Cuba","event":"Winter cultural festivals","note":"Afro-Cuban music and dance, though travel rules for US citizens apply."}]

events.hook: The planet's biggest party, with samba schools, street blocos and glitter from Ipanema to the Sambadrome.
events.overview: Rio's Carnival runs from the Friday before Ash Wednesday (Feb 10, 2027). Its highlight is the Sambadrome parade of the top samba schools, but the free neighborhood blocos are where the city really lets loose. Book flights and lodging well ahead because prices spike and minimum stays apply.
events.costNotes: Carnival surge pricing roughly doubles lodging; Sambadrome tickets are included in the activities budget.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"New Orleans, USA","event":"Mardi Gras (Fat Tuesday Feb 9)","note":"Parades, krewes and brass bands, with no passport needed."},{"destination":"Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago","event":"Trinidad Carnival (Feb 8-9)","note":"Soca, mas bands and J'ouvert, with a more participatory feel."}]

events.event: Battle of the Oranges (Storico Carnevale di Ivrea)
events.hook: Teams on foot and on carts hurl thousands of oranges in a medieval-themed street battle.
events.overview: Ivrea reenacts a legendary revolt against a tyrant with a massive orange fight, held on the last three days of Carnival. Wear a red cap to join in, or watch from the protected stands. It is a distinctive, little-known Italian carnival within reach of Turin.
events.costNotes: Fly into Turin or Milan; lodging in Ivrea is scarce, so stay in Turin and commute.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Venice, Italy","event":"Carnevale di Venezia (ends Feb 9)","note":"Masks, balls and canal processions, but very crowded."},{"destination":"Binche, Belgium","event":"Carnival of Binche (Shrove Tuesday Feb 9)","note":"The UNESCO-listed Gilles parade, with plumed hats and orange tossing."}]

events.hook: At 4 a.m. the city goes dark, then erupts in lantern light, piccolos and drums.
events.overview: Basel's Fasnacht starts with the Morgestraich at 4 a.m. on the Monday after Ash Wednesday, when the street lights are switched off and glowing lanterns parade through the old town. The three days that follow bring cliques with satirical costumes, piccolo and drum music, and onion tart and flour soup. It is a sharp contrast to the louder Mediterranean carnivals.
events.costNotes: Swiss prices are high; consider staying across the border in Germany or France.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Lucerne, Switzerland","event":"Luzerner Fasnacht (Feb 4-9)","note":"Guuggenmusig bands and masked crowds, with a more local feel."},{"destination":"Cologne, Germany","event":"Karneval street celebrations (Feb 4-10)","note":"Costumed parades and beer halls in a more raucous Rhine carnival."}]

events.event: Lantern Festival and Pingxi Sky Lantern Release
events.hook: Thousands of wish-bearing lanterns float into the night sky above old railway tracks.
events.overview: The Lantern Festival closes the Lunar New Year season on Feb 20, 2027. Pingxi's mass sky-lantern launches and Taipei's lantern displays are the highlights. Combine them with night markets, hot springs and Jiufen's teahouses.
events.costNotes: Taiwan is cheap on the ground; flights ease after the Lunar New Year rush.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Chiang Mai, Thailand","event":"Cool-season temple festivals and lantern traditions","note":"Quieter lantern atmosphere, with northern Thai food and temples."},{"destination":"Hoi An, Vietnam","event":"Full Moon Lantern Festival (Feb 20)","note":"Silk lanterns and floating candles along the river on the full moon."}]

events.hook: Thousands of loincloth-clad men fight in freezing temple grounds for a sacred stick.
events.overview: A 500-year-old rite at Saidaiji Kannonin temple in which around 10,000 men crush together in the dark to grab lucky shingi sticks. It is raw, steamy and little known to foreign visitors. Okayama also offers Korakuen garden and the art island of Naoshima nearby.
events.costNotes: Fly into Osaka and take the shinkansen; paid viewing seats are limited.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kyoto, Japan","event":"Plum blossom season at Kitano Tenmangu (begins late Feb)","note":"Early plum blossoms and tea ceremonies, with fewer crowds than cherry season."},{"destination":"Nagano, Japan","event":"Nozawa Onsen winter fire traditions","note":"A rural winter ritual setting with hot springs and skiing."}]

events.event: Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade
events.eventDates: Feb 26 - Feb 28 (parade Sat Feb 27, festival from mid-Feb)
events.hook: Oxford Street turns into a rainbow runway for one of the world's biggest Pride parades.
events.overview: The Mardi Gras parade draws hundreds of thousands to watch floats, dance crews and marching groups, followed by the huge after-party. Around it, the three-week festival includes arts, film and community events. Late summer in Sydney means beach days and harbor swims too.
events.costNotes: Southern-hemisphere summer pricing; book parade viewing spots and party tickets early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Auckland, New Zealand","event":"Summer festivals and Waitangi Day (Feb 6)","note":"Maori culture and harbor-side summer events."},{"destination":"Melbourne, Australia","event":"Midsumma Festival (ends early Feb)","note":"A smaller LGBTQ+ arts festival with a laid-back vibe."}]

events.hook: Giant flaming torches rain sparks over the Nigatsu-do balcony in a ritual that has run for over 1,250 years.
events.overview: Monks of Todai-ji carry huge pine torches along the Nigatsu-do hall each evening of the two-week Shuni-e rite, showering the crowd with embers said to bring protection for the year. The finale on the night of Mar 12 to 13 is the most dramatic. It is a deeply atmospheric, little-publicised alternative to Japan's better-known festivals, and it pairs well with Nara's deer park and the Kyoto/Osaka region at the end of winter.
events.costNotes: Fly into Osaka (KIX/ITM) and base in Nara or Osaka; includes JR passes for day trips.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kyoto, Japan","event":"Plum blossom season and early-spring temple illuminations","note":"Quieter and cheaper than cherry season, with the same temple atmosphere."},{"destination":"Takayama, Japan","event":"Hida winter-to-spring village festivals and onsen season","note":"Snowy mountain culture with far fewer crowds."}]

events.hook: Four days of world music under the gum trees of Botanic Park.
events.overview: WOMADelaide brings international and Indigenous artists, dance, food stalls and late-summer picnics to Adelaide's Botanic Park over the long weekend. It sits in the middle of Adelaide's 'Mad March' season, alongside the end of the Fringe and the nearby Barossa and McLaren Vale wine regions, so you can pair a festival with a wine trip. The date is estimated from the usual second-weekend-of-March pattern.
events.costNotes: Long-haul fare via Sydney or Melbourne; festival-week accommodation is pricey.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Melbourne, Australia","event":"Australian Formula 1 Grand Prix at Albert Park (early March, dates approximate)","note":"Big sporting weekend in a great food city, a short flight from Adelaide."},{"destination":"Auckland, New Zealand","event":"Pasifika Festival and Auckland Arts Festival season","note":"Pacific culture and music with a similar outdoor late-summer feel."}]

events.hook: Austin turns into a 10-day music, film and tech playground, with showcases in every bar.
events.overview: SXSW fills the city with film premieres, hundreds of music showcases, tech keynotes and endless unofficial parties. Even without a badge, free day parties and street energy make it a strong trip for music lovers. Hotels and rentals sell out early. Dates are estimated from the usual mid-March schedule.
events.costNotes: Short flight but festival-week rentals run roughly double normal rates.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Miami, USA","event":"Ultra Music Festival and Miami Music Week (late March, dates approximate)","note":"Electronic music rather than a mixed bill, plus beaches."},{"destination":"New Orleans, USA","event":"St. Patrick's and St. Joseph's Day parades and spring festival season","note":"Brass bands and street parades in a distinct music city."}]

events.hook: Ireland's national day is a multi-day party, with a parade, music and a pint in every hand.
events.overview: Dublin's multi-day festival builds up to the Mar 17 parade, with street theatre, concerts, a family funfair and pub sessions across the city. It is the original St. Patrick's celebration, and the quieter west and Wicklow mountain day trips are easy to add. Exact festival dates are estimated around Wednesday Mar 17.
events.costNotes: Dublin is expensive, and festival week is the peak for rentals.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Galway, Ireland","event":"St. Patrick's parade and traditional music sessions","note":"Smaller, more local, with excellent pub music."},{"destination":"Cheltenham, England","event":"Cheltenham Festival horse racing (Mar 16-19, dates approximate)","note":"The great Irish and British jump racing meeting, with a very Irish crowd."}]

events.hook: Towering satirical sculptures, thunderous daytime fireworks, and a night when the whole city burns.
events.overview: Valencia's UNESCO-listed festival fills the streets with hundreds of elaborate papier-mâché monuments, brass bands, paella and daily mascletà firework shows in the Plaza del Ayuntamiento. The Nit del Foc fireworks and the Cremà bonfires on the night of Mar 19 close the festival. Book accommodation months ahead, and arrive early to see the neighbourhood sculptures before they burn.
events.costNotes: Fare is typically via a European hub; Fallas week rentals carry a premium.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Seville, Spain","event":"Semana Santa processions (Mar 21-28)","note":"Solemn, spectacular Holy Week processions, just a train ride from Valencia's festival timing."},{"destination":"Sitges, Spain","event":"Spring festival season on the Catalan coast","note":"Smaller, seaside option if Fallas crowds feel too much."}]

events.hook: The March equinox is the best time of year for strong geomagnetic activity, so aurora odds peak.
events.overview: Geomagnetic storms are statistically more likely around the equinoxes, and Fairbanks has clear, cold nights, a reliable aurora oval and hot springs to wait in. Stay a few nights to give yourself several tries, and combine it with dog-sledding and the ice sculptures of the World Ice Art Championships, which usually run into late March. Aurora activity cannot be guaranteed, so allow extra nights.
events.costNotes: Experiential cost includes aurora tours, a rental vehicle and winter gear.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Yellowknife, Canada","event":"Equinox aurora season","note":"Excellent odds with several tour operators."},{"destination":"Tromsø, Norway","event":"Equinox aurora season","note":"A coastal option with a wider range of activities."}]

events.hook: Streets are carpeted in sawdust and flower alfombras, then trampled by processions.
events.overview: Antigua's Holy Week is among the most striking in Latin America, with enormous processional floats carried by hundreds of bearers through streets covered in intricate sawdust carpets. Good Friday, Mar 26, is the high point, and Easter Sunday is Mar 28. The setting is colonial, volcano-framed and photogenic. Accommodation fills early, so book far ahead.
events.costNotes: Fly into Guatemala City and take a transfer; Holy Week rates apply.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Seville, Spain","event":"Semana Santa","note":"Europe's most famous Holy Week, with brotherhoods and saeta singing."},{"destination":"Taxco, Mexico","event":"Semana Santa processions","note":"Hooded penitents in a hillside silver town."}]

events.eventDates: Mar 21 (Holika Dahan) - Mar 22 (Holi); Braj celebrations begin about a week earlier
events.hook: The world's biggest colour fight happens where Holi began, in Krishna's home town.
events.overview: Mathura and Vrindavan stage the most traditional Holi, with temple celebrations, flower and colour throwing and the Holika Dahan bonfires on Mar 21 before the main colour day. The lead-up weeks include events like Lathmar Holi nearby. It is chaotic, joyful and messy, so wear old clothes and protect your phone. Fly into Delhi and travel by train or road.
events.costNotes: Low local costs; the flight is the main expense.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Jaipur, India","event":"Holi and Elephant Festival","note":"A more organised celebration with palace events."},{"destination":"Kathmandu, Nepal","event":"Fagu Purnima (Holi)","note":"Colour celebrations with a Himalayan backdrop."}]

events.eventDates: Mar 22 - Apr 3 (Tokyo bloom to full bloom)
events.hook: Tokyo turns pink for about a week, and the whole country goes hanami.
events.overview: Full bloom in Tokyo usually arrives in the last week of March, with Kyoto and Osaka following within days. Picnic under the trees in Ueno or Shinjuku Gyoen, walk the Meguro River at night and add a rail trip to Kyoto. The exact peak varies with spring temperatures, so build in flexibility and track forecasts closer to the date.
events.costNotes: Peak-season Tokyo accommodation is expensive; book very early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kyoto, Japan","event":"Cherry blossoms (usually peak around Apr 1-5)","note":"Classic temple and canal views, slightly after Tokyo."},{"destination":"Washington, D.C., USA","event":"National Cherry Blossom Festival (late March to April, dates approximate)","note":"Much shorter trip from LAX, with a similar spring feel."}]

events.hook: Run or cheer along 56 km of one of the world's most scenic road routes.
events.overview: The Two Oceans ultramarathon winds around the Cape Peninsula between the Atlantic and Indian Oceans, with a half marathon and shorter races the same weekend. Easter weekend in 2027 falls on Mar 27-28, so dates are approximate and tied to the Easter calendar. Late March is also a great time for Table Mountain hikes, the winelands and penguins at Boulders, with the summer crowds thinning.
events.costNotes: Long-haul fare via Europe or the Gulf; local costs are low; entry fees are not included.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Ndutu, Tanzania","event":"Serengeti wildebeest calving season (typically ends in March)","note":"Hundreds of thousands of calves born, with predators close by."},{"destination":"Stellenbosch, South Africa","event":"Cape winelands harvest season","note":"Late harvest celebrations an hour from Cape Town."}]

events.hook: Watch (or run) the legendary six-stage ultra through the Sahara's dunes and dry riverbeds.
events.overview: A self-supported multi-day ultramarathon of about 250 km across the Moroccan Sahara, with hundreds of runners from around the world. Spectators can base themselves in Ouarzazate and Merzouga, see checkpoints and the bivouac atmosphere, and add desert camps and kasbah visits.
events.costNotes: Spectator budget with desert transfers and a guide; runner entry fees (several thousand dollars) are not included.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Marrakech, Morocco","event":"Spring souk season and Atlas day trips","note":"Easy add-on base with a direct-ish route from Casablanca and Sahara tours."},{"destination":"Wadi Rum, Jordan","event":"Desert trekking season","note":"Another dramatic desert-endurance vibe with Bedouin camps in peak spring."}]

events.hook: A week of flamenco dresses, sherry, horse carriages and nightly dancing in a city of tents.
events.overview: Seville's famous spring fair turns the Los Remedios fairground into a village of hundreds of striped casetas, opening with the lighting of thousands of lanterns. Locals in traje de flamenca and riders on horseback fill the streets, and sevillanas, fino and fried fish run day and night. Orange blossom and warm weather make the whole city lovely.
events.costNotes: Fair-week housing is at a premium; most casetas are private, so budget for public ones and tapas.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Jerez de la Frontera, Spain","event":"Sherry country spring events","note":"Horse culture and bodegas close to Seville, quieter and cheaper."},{"destination":"Córdoba, Spain","event":"Cordoba spring courtyards season","note":"Patio festival comes in May, but April is good for blossom-filled old-town walks."}]

events.hook: Thailand's New Year turns a whole moated city into the world's biggest water fight.
events.overview: Songkran marks the traditional Thai New Year with temple ceremonies, sand pagodas, and three days of citywide water throwing. Chiang Mai is the best base, with the moat as the focal point, plus parades, Buddha image processions and street food everywhere. Expect heat, soaked clothes and total joy.
events.costNotes: Flights and rooms spike around the holiday, so book months in advance.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Luang Prabang, Laos","event":"Pii Mai Lao (Lao New Year)","note":"A gentler, more traditional take on the same New Year water rituals."},{"destination":"Bagan, Myanmar","event":"Thingyan water festival","note":"Burmese New Year water festival, though travel conditions need checking before you book."}]

events.hook: Giant gilded floats and mechanical puppets roll through a perfectly preserved Edo-era town.
events.overview: One of Japan's three most beautiful festivals, Takayama's Sanno Matsuri parades elaborate wooden yatai floats with karakuri puppets through old merchant streets, with lantern-lit floats at night. Cherry blossoms are often still around in the Hida mountains. It's far less crowded than Kyoto.
events.costNotes: Hotels in Takayama fill up early, so many travelers stay in nearby Gifu or Toyama.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kyoto, Japan","event":"Miyako Odori geisha dances","note":"Spring dances in Gion Kobu, with late cherry blossoms in higher gardens."},{"destination":"Kanazawa, Japan","event":"Spring garden and blossom season","note":"Kenrokuen's cherry trees and a historic district, easy by train from Takayama."}]

events.hook: The world's oldest annual marathon, run on Patriots' Day with a million spectators lining the course.
events.overview: From Hopkinton to Boylston Street, the 131st Boston Marathon is a city-wide holiday with deep history. Cheer at Wellesley's scream tunnel or Heartbreak Hill, then add Red Sox at Fenway and Freedom Trail walks. Spring in New England adds early blooms and long evenings.
events.costNotes: Marathon-week hotel and Airbnb rates are high; a shorter stay would cut costs a lot.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"New York, USA","event":"Spring theater and Tribeca Festival lead-in","note":"A nearby big-city alternative with a similar flight cost."},{"destination":"Washington, DC, USA","event":"National Cherry Blossom Festival wrap-up","note":"Late-season blossoms and festival events in early April."}]

events.hook: Two weekends of jazz, zydeco, gospel and crawfish at the Fair Grounds.
events.overview: Jazz Fest fills the Fair Grounds with hundreds of acts across a dozen stages, plus Louisiana food, crafts and parades. Evening shows around the French Quarter and Frenchmen Street extend the fun. It's one of America's great food and music events.
events.costNotes: Includes festival tickets for several days and evening shows; lodging peaks on festival weekends.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Lafayette, USA","event":"Festival International de Louisiane","note":"Cajun and Creole culture and music in the heart of Acadiana, usually late April."},{"destination":"Memphis, USA","event":"Beale Street music season","note":"Another music-driven Southern city with great barbecue."}]

events.hook: Thousands of cherry trees bloom around a castle moat, and petals carpet the water pink.
events.overview: Hirosaki Park in northern Honshu has over 2,500 cherry trees around its original castle keep. The 'hanaikada' petal-covered moat is a highlight, and the park is lit up for night viewing with food stalls and old-fashioned fairground attractions. It blooms late, so it extends the sakura season well beyond Tokyo and Kyoto.
events.costNotes: Peak bloom varies by weather, so book flexible lodging; rooms are tight in Hirosaki during the festival.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Matsumae, Japan","event":"Matsumae Park cherry blossoms","note":"Hokkaido's southern tip has some of Japan's latest sakura, with many varieties."},{"destination":"Kakunodate, Japan","event":"Samurai district cherry blossom season","note":"A Tohoku town with weeping cherries along the old samurai houses, usually mid to late April."}]

events.hook: Floats made of millions of hyacinths, tulips and daffodils glide through the Dutch bulb fields.
events.overview: This one-day parade runs about 40 km from Noordwijk to Haarlem and passes through the colourful bulb fields. Floats are decorated with millions of fresh flowers, and the evening show lights them up. Pair it with Keukenhof at its late-season best and the fields around Lisse.
events.costNotes: Stay in Haarlem or Leiden; cycling and train costs are modest.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Keukenhof, Netherlands","event":"Keukenhof tulip season","note":"Late-season blooms usually overlap with the parade."},{"destination":"Bruges, Belgium","event":"Spring canal-town season","note":"A quieter old-town base just a few hours from the Dutch bulb fields."}]

events.hook: A hushed dawn service at the Australian War Memorial draws tens of thousands in remembrance.
events.overview: Anzac Day commemorates Australian and New Zealand soldiers with dawn services, veterans' marches and gatherings across both countries. The Canberra service at the Australian War Memorial is the nation's central ceremony, followed by a national ceremony and parade. Autumn weather is crisp and clear, ideal for a trip with Sydney or the Snowy Mountains.
events.costNotes: Canberra rooms are scarce around Anzac Day, so book early or stay in Queanbeyan.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Wellington, New Zealand","event":"Anzac Day Dawn Service at the Cenotaph","note":"A smaller, intimate service plus the national war memorial."},{"destination":"Gallipoli, Turkey","event":"Anzac Day Dawn Service at Anzac Cove","note":"The original site of the commemoration; access is tightly controlled, so check ticketing."}]

events.hook: Epitaph processions, brass bands and clay pots hurled from balconies make Corfu's Easter unforgettable.
events.overview: Orthodox Easter falls on May 2, 2027, and Corfu is famous for its observances: candlelit Good Friday processions with local philharmonic bands, and the Holy Saturday custom of throwing clay pots from windows. The week ends with Easter lamb feasts and fireworks. The island is green and quiet before the summer crowds.
events.costNotes: Easter week is busy for locals, so book early; the rest of April is moderately priced.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Patmos, Greece","event":"Holy Week at the Cave of the Apocalypse","note":"A quieter island with deep monastic traditions during Holy Week."},{"destination":"Jerusalem, Israel","event":"Orthodox Holy Week and Holy Fire","note":"Check travel conditions, but it is a central place for the Orthodox Easter rituals."}]

events.hook: Two minutes of thoroughbred thunder wrapped in mint juleps, big hats and a week of Bourbon Country parties.
events.overview: The 153rd Run for the Roses is held at Churchill Downs on the first Saturday of May. Derby week adds Oaks Day, the Great Steamboat Race and bourbon-trail tastings. The infield is a spectacle in its own right, so it is worth building a trip around.
events.costNotes: Derby-week lodging is surge-priced and reserved seats cost far more than infield entry; most visitors stay fewer than 12 nights.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Baltimore, USA","event":"Preakness Stakes","note":"Second jewel of the Triple Crown, mid-May, with a looser, party-heavy infield."},{"destination":"Ottawa, Canada","event":"Canadian Tulip Festival","note":"Roughly a million tulips in bloom across the capital in mid-May."}]

events.hook: Red carpets, world premieres and Riviera glamour for twelve days.
events.overview: The world's most prestigious film festival takes over the Croisette each May. Public access is limited, but the open-air Cinéma de la Plage screenings, star-spotting and Riviera atmosphere make it a bucket-list trip for cinephiles. Exact dates are announced about a year ahead.
events.costNotes: Cannes lodging peaks hard during the festival; staying in Nice or Antibes saves a lot.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Brighton, UK","event":"Brighton Festival","note":"England's biggest curated arts festival runs through May."},{"destination":"Monaco, Monaco","event":"Monaco Grand Prix weekend","note":"Falls in late May or early June depending on the F1 calendar; check before booking."}]

events.hook: Villagers launch homemade rockets into the sky to beg the rain gods for a good monsoon.
events.overview: In Isan, Thailand's northeast, the Rocket Festival combines parades, music, dancing and the firing of huge homemade rockets. The festival is held around the second weekend of May and ahead of the rains. It is rowdy, genuinely local and rarely visited by foreigners.
events.costNotes: Fly to Bangkok then take a domestic flight or bus; Yasothon stays are very cheap.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Bangkok, Thailand","event":"Royal Ploughing Ceremony","note":"Ancient royal rite that forecasts the harvest, held in mid-May."},{"destination":"Vientiane, Laos","event":"Boun Bang Fai","note":"Laos holds its own rocket festivals in May."}]

events.hook: Teams race three giant wooden pillars with saints on top up a mountain through a medieval Umbrian town.
events.overview: Every May 15 the Ceraioli of Gubbio, in their colored shirts, sprint through the stone streets carrying 400 kg wooden 'candles' in a tradition about 800 years old. It starts with dawn drums and ends with a frantic run up Monte Ingino. Few foreign visitors know it, so it feels like a local celebration.
events.costNotes: Fly into Rome; the in-town stay is cheap but book early for festival day.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Assisi, Italy","event":"Calendimaggio","note":"Medieval spring pageant in early May; confirm the date, as it varies."},{"destination":"El Rocío, Spain","event":"Romería del Rocío","note":"Pentecost pilgrimage of horse-drawn wagons around May 14-17."}]

events.hook: A 500-person Heian-era court procession winds through Kyoto in silk robes and hollyhock leaves.
events.overview: One of Kyoto's three great festivals, Aoi Matsuri recreates an imperial procession of oxcarts, horses and courtiers between the Imperial Palace and the Kamo shrines. It runs on May 15 every year and is postponed a day if it rains. Late spring also means green maples and fewer crowds than cherry-blossom season.
events.costNotes: A weak yen helps, and paid grandstand seats are a modest add-on.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Tokyo, Japan","event":"Kanda Matsuri","note":"Held only in odd years, so 2027 is on; the big procession falls around May 15."},{"destination":"Fukuoka, Japan","event":"Hakata Dontaku","note":"Two-million-strong street parade festival on May 3-4."}]

events.hook: A whole nation in folk costume and ice cream waves flags down the royal avenue.
events.overview: Norway's National Day features children's parades, brass bands and the royal family greeting crowds from the palace balcony. Nearly everyone wears a bunad, the regional folk dress, and there are hot dogs and ice cream everywhere. It is one of Europe's most joyful and family-friendly national days.
events.costNotes: Norway is expensive for food and transport; 12 days is long for the event itself.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Bergen, Norway","event":"Syttende Mai parade and Bergen International Festival","note":"The country's biggest children's parade; the festival starts around May 19."},{"destination":"Helsinki, Finland","event":"Vappu (May Day)","note":"A big student-cap street party on May 1, with picnics and sparkling wine."}]

events.hook: Colombo glows with lantern pandals, free food stalls and temple illuminations for the Buddha's birth, enlightenment and passing.
events.overview: During Vesak week, Sri Lanka's most sacred Buddhist festival, towns are strung with giant illuminated pandals telling Jataka tales. Dansalas hand out free food and drinks, and devotees fill temples dressed in white. Pair it with Kandy's Temple of the Tooth and the hill country.
events.costNotes: Long flight via the Gulf or Singapore; on-the-ground costs are low.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Borobudur, Indonesia","event":"Waisak at Borobudur","note":"Monks and lantern release at the world's largest Buddhist temple, around the same full moon."},{"destination":"Seoul, South Korea","event":"Lotus Lantern Festival","note":"Lantern parade for Buddha's Birthday, around mid-May."}]

events.hook: Over a million wildebeest mass and start crossing the crocodile-filled Grumeti River.
events.overview: After the calving season, the herds move north-west through the Western Corridor. Timing depends on rain, but late May to June is the classic window for rutting herds and the first river crossings. It is a world-class natural phenomenon with fewer vehicles than the Mara peak.
events.costNotes: Based on lodges and tented camps rather than Airbnb, with park fees and a safari vehicle.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Okavango Delta, Botswana","event":"Annual flood arrives","note":"Waters peak May to August, making wildlife-rich mokoro trips."},{"destination":"Fès, Morocco","event":"Fès Festival of World Sacred Music","note":"Spiritual music in a medieval medina, typically late May or June; confirm the date."}]

events.hook: The Opera House and harbour become a canvas for the Southern Hemisphere's biggest light show.
events.overview: Vivid Sydney transforms the harbour with light sculptures, projections on the Opera House sails, and music and ideas programmes. Autumn weather is mild and the city is walkable. Dates follow the usual pattern of late May to mid June and may shift slightly.
events.costNotes: Festival-season accommodation is pricey near Circular Quay; the main light walk is free.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Auckland, New Zealand","event":"Auckland Writers Festival","note":"Mid-May literary festival in a good-value city."},{"destination":"Hobart, Australia","event":"Dark Mofo","note":"Midwinter arts festival, typically June; check dates before booking."}]

events.hook: Thirty-three cars, 200 laps and 300,000 fans at the Greatest Spectacle in Racing.
events.overview: The Indy 500 is held on the Sunday of Memorial Day weekend at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway. The weekend includes the Carb Day practice and concert, and a famous pre-race ceremony. It is one of motorsport's big three and a pure American tradition.
events.costNotes: Race-weekend lodging is surge-priced; Memorial Day weekend flights are higher.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Charlotte, USA","event":"Coca-Cola 600","note":"NASCAR's longest race, run the same evening."},{"destination":"Memphis, USA","event":"Memphis in May World Championship Barbecue Cooking Contest","note":"Pit masters, blues and BBQ on the riverfront in mid-May."}]

events.hook: Thundering drums and racing dragon boats in one of the world's most photogenic harbors.
events.overview: Tuen Ng falls on the 5th day of the 5th lunar month, which is June 9 in 2027. Teams race brightly painted dragon boats at Stanley, Sha Tin and Tsim Sha Tsui, and the city eats zongzi (sticky rice dumplings). Combine it with dim sum crawls and the Peak.
events.costNotes: Hotel and Airbnb prices rise around the public holiday, so book early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Taipei, Taiwan","event":"Dragon Boat Festival races","note":"Races at Dajia Riverside Park, with egg-balancing folk customs and great street food."},{"destination":"Gangneung, South Korea","event":"Gangneung Danoje Festival","note":"UNESCO-listed Dano celebration on the same lunar date, with shamanic rites, wrestling and a big market."}]

events.hook: A full day and night of flat-out endurance racing, with campsite parties and a rolling grid of hypercars.
events.overview: The world's most famous endurance race is run at the Circuit de la Sarthe, with the drivers' parade through town and the start on Saturday afternoon. Fans camp in the infield, ride the Ferris wheel and watch through the night. It pairs well with Loire Valley chateaux and Normandy.
events.costNotes: Local lodging is scarce and pricey that week, so many fans stay in Tours or Angers.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Paris, France","event":"Fête de la Musique (June 21)","note":"Free concerts on every corner in the city that invented the night."},{"destination":"Dublin, Ireland","event":"Bloomsday (June 16)","note":"Joyce readings, costumes and pub crawls across the city."}]

events.hook: Tens of thousands of dancers take over Hokkaido's capital in a blast of neon costumes and taiko.
events.overview: Around 30,000 dancers in teams of up to 150 perform choreographed naruko dances on stages and streets across Sapporo. It is loud, joyful, and far less crowded with foreign tourists than Japan's big summer festivals. Cool Hokkaido early summer makes it easy to add Otaru and lavender-country day trips.
events.costNotes: Dates usually run Wednesday to Sunday in the second week of June, so confirm before booking.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kanazawa, Japan","event":"Hyakumangoku Matsuri","note":"Early June samurai-era procession and torchlit noh in a well-preserved castle town, dates approximate."},{"destination":"Kamakura, Japan","event":"Hydrangea (ajisai) peak at Meigetsu-in and Hase-dera","note":"Mid-June bloom among temples, easy to pair with Tokyo."}]

events.hook: The world's oldest and largest ultramarathon runs 90 km between Durban and Pietermaritzburg and is a spectacle even for spectators.
events.overview: More than 15,000 runners race the Comrades route through the KwaZulu-Natal hills, with the direction alternating yearly. Crowds line the road with braais and cheering, and the finish at the cut-off gun is famously emotional. Add a Drakensberg or Zulu battlefields extension.
events.costNotes: Dry-season winter prices are moderate, but the race weekend raises hotel rates.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Reykjavik, Iceland","event":"Midnight Sun Run (late June)","note":"Running through 24-hour daylight, dates approximate."},{"destination":"Chamonix, France","event":"Mont-Blanc Marathon (late June)","note":"Trail running under the Alps, dates approximate."}]

events.hook: The rising of the Pleiades marks the Māori New Year with dawn ceremonies and glowing light shows.
events.overview: Matariki is a national holiday on Friday, June 25, 2027, and events run for about two weeks. Expect pre-dawn hautapu ceremonies, storytelling, kapa haka and lantern displays. Wellington's Te Papa and waterfront are a strong base, with Rotorua nearby.
events.costNotes: Winter is low season, but holiday-weekend accommodation is pricier.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sydney, Australia","event":"Vivid Sydney","note":"Light, music and ideas festival from late May to mid-June, dates approximate."},{"destination":"Queenstown, New Zealand","event":"Queenstown Winter Festival","note":"Snow, fireworks and parties in late June, dates approximate."}]

events.hook: The world's biggest greenfield music festival returns after its 2026 fallow year.
events.overview: Worthy Farm hosts hundreds of acts, from legends on the Pyramid Stage to late-night Shangri-La. After a fallow year it usually returns in the last week of June. Tickets sell out in minutes in the autumn before.
events.costNotes: Includes roughly a $550 ticket, and dates and the line-up should be confirmed once announced.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Roskilde, Denmark","event":"Roskilde Festival","note":"Huge Nordic music festival, usually late June to early July, dates approximate."},{"destination":"Barcelona, Spain","event":"Primavera Sound","note":"Big city festival in late May and early June, dates approximate."}]

events.hook: An Inca winter solstice ceremony staged at Sacsayhuamán above the old capital.
events.overview: Inti Raymi honors the sun god with a procession from Qorikancha to Sacsayhuamán and a ritual performed in Quechua. The whole of Cusco celebrates for days. It is the best time to combine with Machu Picchu in dry season.
events.costNotes: Includes grandstand seating, but book Machu Picchu permits and trains early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Iquitos, Peru","event":"Fiesta de San Juan (June 24)","note":"An Amazon celebration with juanes, music and river baptisms."},{"destination":"Otavalo, Ecuador","event":"Inti Raymi / San Juan celebrations","note":"Highland Kichwa festivities with dance and music, late June."}]

events.hook: Dance around a flower-wreathed maypole on Sweden's most beloved night of the year.
events.overview: Midsummer Eve falls on Friday, June 25, 2027. In Dalarna villages around Lake Siljan, locals raise the maypole, wear folk costumes and eat herring, new potatoes and strawberries. Daylight lasts nearly all night.
events.costNotes: Sweden is pricey, and cabins near Lake Siljan book out months ahead.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Helsinki, Finland","event":"Juhannus (Midsummer)","note":"Bonfires and lake cottages on the same weekend."},{"destination":"Riga, Latvia","event":"Jāņi / Līgo (June 23-24)","note":"Flower crowns, oak wreaths and song festivities, at lower prices."}]

events.hook: Two rival bull teams battle in a giant Amazon stadium, and the whole river island joins in.
events.overview: Boi Garantido (red) and Boi Caprichoso (blue) perform huge operatic floats, drumming and Amazonian legends in the Bumbódromo. It is often described as Brazil's second-biggest party after Carnival. Reach it by boat or flight from Manaus.
events.costNotes: Tickets, boat transfers and Manaus add-ons drive the experiential cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Caruaru, Brazil","event":"São João festival","note":"Northeast Brazil's June bonfires, quadrilha dancing and forró."},{"destination":"Salvador, Brazil","event":"São João (June 23-24)","note":"Bahian street parties and fire displays."}]

events.hook: Tahiti's biggest cultural festival, with dance, drumming, canoe racing and traditional sports.
events.overview: Heiva i Tahiti is the main Polynesian cultural celebration, with competitions of dance and chant, outrigger canoe races, stone lifting and fruit-carrying races. Performances take place at To'ata Square in Papeete. It is a lesser-known event that combines culture with the islands' beaches.
events.costNotes: Food and lodging in Polynesia are expensive, and the budget includes an inter-island hop to Moorea.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Rarotonga, Cook Islands","event":"Te Maeva Nui","note":"A national culture festival, held in early August."},{"destination":"Moorea, French Polynesia","event":"Humpback whale season","note":"Whales visit the lagoons from about July to October."}]

events.event: Great Wildebeest Migration: Mara River crossings
events.hook: Hundreds of thousands of wildebeest plunge into crocodile-filled rivers.
events.overview: From July the herds arrive at the Mara River, where they cross between Tanzania and Kenya. The timing of each crossing depends on the rains and the herd, so allow several days. Mara conservancies offer fewer vehicles than the main reserve.
events.costNotes: Safari camps are pricey in peak season, and the budget includes park fees and game drives.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Serengeti, Tanzania","event":"Northern Serengeti crossings","note":"The same herds cross from the Tanzanian side with fewer visitors."},{"destination":"Kigali, Rwanda","event":"Gorilla trekking","note":"Dry-season trekking, which suits a wildlife itinerary."}]

events.hook: Ten days of rodeo, chuckwagon racing and pancake breakfasts in the world's biggest cowboy party.
events.overview: The Calgary Stampede is a 10-day rodeo and exhibition with chuckwagon races, a huge downtown parade, midway rides and free pancake breakfasts on every corner. The whole city turns western. Add day trips to Banff and the Rockies for a full trip.
events.costNotes: Stampede week lifts lodging prices sharply, and the budget includes rodeo and grandstand tickets plus a rental car for the Rockies.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Cheyenne, USA","event":"Cheyenne Frontier Days","note":"The 'Daddy of 'Em All' rodeo runs in mid to late July, with a similar western vibe."},{"destination":"Banff, Canada","event":"Rocky Mountain summer season","note":"Hiking and lakes right beside Calgary, best combined with the Stampede."}]

events.hook: The Tour de France starts in Barcelona, then climbs into the Pyrenees.
events.overview: The 2027 Tour opens in Barcelona with the team presentation and the first stages through Catalonia. Fans line the roads and the city hosts big fan zones. Follow the race into the Pyrenees or finish at the Champs-Élysées on Jul 25.
events.costNotes: Barcelona lodging is expensive in July, and the budget includes trains and a few stage-viewing days.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Andorra la Vella, Andorra","event":"Pyrenees Tour stages","note":"Watch the mountain stages from the roadside in the high Pyrenees."},{"destination":"Paris, France","event":"Tour finale on the Champs-Élysées","note":"Finish the trip at the final stage on Jul 25, with Bastille Day on Jul 14 earlier in the month."}]

events.hook: Nine days in white and red, with bulls running through the streets at 8am.
events.overview: San Fermín opens with the Chupinazo rocket at noon on Jul 6 and ends with the candlelit 'Pobre de Mí' on Jul 14. Daily encierros, giants' parades, brass bands and all-night street parties fill the old town. Most visitors watch the run from the stands or a balcony rather than run it.
events.costNotes: Festival week prices are very high, and many visitors stay in nearby cities such as San Sebastián.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"San Sebastián, Spain","event":"Basque pintxos and beaches","note":"A good base only an hour away, with world-class food."},{"destination":"Siena, Italy","event":"Palio di Siena","note":"The medieval horse race is held on Jul 2, with a similar level of local passion."}]

events.hook: Mongolia's 'three manly games' of wrestling, archery and horse racing on the green steppe.
events.overview: Naadam is Mongolia's national festival, with a stadium opening ceremony in Ulaanbaatar followed by wrestling and archery. The horse races take place out on the steppe. Pair it with nights in a ger camp and the green summer landscape.
events.costNotes: Flights are via Seoul or Tokyo, and the budget includes ger camp stays, a driver and Naadam tickets.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Karakorum, Mongolia","event":"Village Naadam","note":"Smaller local Naadams around the steppe are more intimate than the capital's."},{"destination":"Leh, India","event":"Ladakh summer festival season","note":"Another high-altitude culture trip, with monastery festivals through the summer."}]

events.hook: Towering festival floats roll through Kyoto's streets in Japan's most famous matsuri.
events.overview: Gion Matsuri is a month-long Yasaka Shrine festival. The peak is the Yoiyama evenings from Jul 14 to 16, with lantern-lit streets, then the Yamaboko Junko float parade on Jul 17 and a second parade on Jul 24. Watch the wooden floats in kimono-clad crowds.
events.costNotes: Kyoto is hot and busy in July, and the budget includes a rail pass and day trips to Osaka and Nara.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Fukuoka, Japan","event":"Hakata Gion Yamakasa","note":"Teams race heavy floats at dawn, climaxing on Jul 15."},{"destination":"Osaka, Japan","event":"Tenjin Matsuri","note":"A river procession with fireworks, held around Jul 24 and 25."}]

events.hook: The world's biggest electronic music festival, with stages built like fantasy kingdoms.
events.overview: Tomorrowland takes over De Schorre park in Boom for two weekends, with hundreds of DJs on elaborate stages. Camping and the Dreamville area add to the experience. Tickets sell out within minutes, so register early.
events.costNotes: The budget includes a weekend ticket (around $400) and trains to Brussels, Bruges and Ghent.
