events.alternates: [{"destination":"Novi Sad, Serbia","event":"EXIT Festival","note":"A fortress festival, usually held in July."},{"destination":"Ghent, Belgium","event":"Gentse Feesten","note":"A free city-wide festival from about Jul 16 to 25, with music and street theatre."}]

events.eventDates: Jul 19 and 26 (Lunes del Cerro), with events through the month
events.hook: Oaxaca's eight regions dance in feathers and embroidery on a hillside amphitheatre.
events.overview: Guelaguetza is Oaxaca's major indigenous cultural festival, with delegations performing traditional dances on the Cerro del Fortín on the last two Mondays of July. The city also has parades, mezcal tastings, mole kitchens and 'calendas' in the streets. It is a lesser-known alternative to Mexico's big-name festivals.
events.costNotes: A direct flight to Oaxaca is not always available from LAX, and the budget includes official stand tickets.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Mexico City, Mexico","event":"Summer food and culture season","note":"Pair Oaxaca with a few days of museums and street food."},{"destination":"Cusco, Peru","event":"Andean winter festivals","note":"Dry season in the Andes, ahead of Inti Raymi and Machu Picchu trips."}]

events.hook: Three days of rock, indie and electronic music in the Japanese Alps.
events.overview: Fuji Rock is held at the Naeba Ski Resort in Niigata, with several stages spread through the forest. The line-up mixes global headliners with Japanese acts, and the festival is known for its cleanliness and mountain scenery. Add Tokyo and the Japan Alps before or after.
events.costNotes: The budget includes a 3-day ticket, bullet-train transfers from Tokyo and Naeba lodging.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Tokyo, Japan","event":"Sumida River Fireworks","note":"A big fireworks night, usually held in late July."},{"destination":"Gwangju, South Korea","event":"Summer music festival season","note":"Korea's summer festivals run through July, with plenty of options in and around Seoul."}]

events.event: Great Wildebeest Migration: Mara River Crossings
events.hook: Over a million wildebeest throw themselves into crocodile-filled rivers.
events.overview: In August the herds are in the Mara, and the river crossings are among the most dramatic wildlife scenes on Earth. Timing is unpredictable, so staying several days increases your odds. Game drives also bring lions, cheetahs and elephants.
events.costNotes: Camp rates and park fees are at their peak in migration season.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Serengeti (Kogatende), Tanzania","event":"Northern Serengeti Mara River crossings","note":"The Tanzanian side, usually quieter and with fewer vehicles."},{"destination":"Okavango Delta, Botswana","event":"Peak dry-season wildlife viewing","note":"Water-based safaris and big concentrations of animals, though not a time-locked event."}]

events.hook: Giant glowing warrior floats roll through northern Japan while thousands of haneto dancers chant.
events.overview: Huge illuminated paper-lantern floats parade nightly through Aomori, accompanied by taiko drums and costumed dancers who jump and shout 'Rassera!'. The festival ends with a fireworks-lit sea parade on Aug 7. Visitors can rent a dancer costume and join in.
events.costNotes: Aomori hotels fill months ahead, so many visitors stay in nearby Hirosaki or Hachinohe.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Akita, Japan","event":"Kanto Festival (about Aug 3-6)","note":"Performers balance towering lantern poles on their foreheads and hips."},{"destination":"Tokushima, Japan","event":"Awa Odori (Aug 12-15)","note":"Japan's biggest dance festival, with about 100,000 dancers over four nights."}]

events.event: Total Solar Eclipse of Aug 2, 2027 (Luxor, ~6 min totality)
events.hook: The longest total solar eclipse on land for over a century, over the temples of Luxor.
events.overview: On Aug 2, 2027 the Moon's shadow crosses Egypt, and Luxor gets about 6 minutes 20 seconds of totality, among the longest of the 21st century. You can watch it from the Valley of the Kings or Karnak with clear August skies, then spend the rest of the trip among the tombs and temples.
events.costNotes: Eclipse demand will push Luxor hotel and flight prices well above normal, and August is very hot.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Jaén, Spain","event":"Total solar eclipse, Aug 2, with about 4.5 minutes of totality in southern Spain","note":"Easier logistics and cooler evenings, but low sun and the risk of crowds and traffic."},{"destination":"Tangier, Morocco","event":"Total solar eclipse, Aug 2, over the Strait of Gibraltar","note":"Pairs the eclipse with medina and coastal travel, with about 4+ minutes of totality."}]

events.hook: The world's largest arts festival fills every pub, cellar and church with thousands of shows.
events.overview: For about three weeks Edinburgh hosts comedy, theatre, circus, cabaret and music from around the world. It runs alongside the International Festival and the Military Tattoo, so the city is busy morning to late night. Cheap tickets and street performers on the Royal Mile make it easy to see a lot.
events.costNotes: Edinburgh accommodation is at its yearly peak, and the dates are an estimate pending the official announcement.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Salzburg, Austria","event":"Salzburg Festival (runs through late Aug)","note":"A classical, opera and theatre counterpoint to the Fringe's chaos."},{"destination":"Budapest, Hungary","event":"Sziget Festival (usually mid-Aug)","note":"A week-long island music festival with a huge international lineup."}]

events.hook: Yolngu people host four days of ceremony, song, dance and forums in Arnhem Land.
events.overview: Garma is Australia's leading Indigenous gathering, held at Gulkula in northeast Arnhem Land. Visitors take part in bunggul (dance) ceremonies, art workshops, bush-food meals and policy forums. It is a rare chance to learn directly from Yolngu elders. The exact dates are usually confirmed a year ahead and often fall around the first weekend of August.
events.costNotes: Experiential cost includes the festival ticket and remote-area transfers; the dates are estimated.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Darwin, Australia","event":"Darwin Festival (mid-Aug)","note":"Music, theatre and food in the dry-season Top End."},{"destination":"Brisbane, Australia","event":"Ekka (Royal Queensland Show, early-mid Aug)","note":"A big agricultural fair known for strawberry sundaes and sideshows."}]

events.hook: Ten bareback riders thunder around the Piazza del Campo in a 90-second race rooted in medieval rivalries.
events.overview: The Palio on Aug 16 pits Siena's contrade (neighborhoods) against each other in a race of about three laps around the packed shell-shaped piazza. In the days before, there are trial races, flag-waving parades, contrada dinners and a blessing of the horses. It is intense and tradition-heavy, and the whole town takes part.
events.costNotes: Many travelers base in Florence or nearby towns and day-trip, since Siena rooms are scarce.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Verona, Italy","event":"Arena di Verona Opera Festival (summer season)","note":"Opera performed in a Roman amphitheatre."},{"destination":"Sinj, Croatia","event":"Sinjska Alka (early Aug)","note":"A 300-year-old knights' lance tournament, little known to tourists."}]

events.hook: About 1,000 Native artists sell jewelry, pottery and textiles around the historic plaza.
events.overview: The oldest and largest juried Native American art market in the world fills downtown Santa Fe each August, with artists from over 100 tribes. There are fashion shows, a Best of Show competition and events at nearby museums. It is a chance to buy directly from artists and meet them.
events.costNotes: Santa Fe lodging spikes sharply that weekend, so booking early matters.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Gallup, New Mexico, USA","event":"Inter-Tribal Indian Ceremonial (mid-Aug)","note":"A long-running gathering of dance, rodeo and arts."},{"destination":"Crow Agency, Montana, USA","event":"Crow Fair Powwow & Rodeo (third week of Aug)","note":"The self-described 'Tepee Capital of the World', with parades and dancing."}]

events.hook: Lord Krishna's birthplace celebrates with midnight aartis, swings and temple pageantry.
events.overview: Mathura and Vrindavan are the center of Janmashtami, with temples decorated, devotional singing, and a midnight celebration of Krishna's birth. Jhulan (swing) decorations and tableaux fill the streets. The dates depend on the lunar calendar, so check the panchang closer to the time.
events.costNotes: Prices are low, but this is monsoon season and crowds are heavy during the festival.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Mumbai, India","event":"Dahi Handi (the day after Janmashtami)","note":"Teams build human pyramids to break high-hung pots of curd."},{"destination":"Dwarka, India","event":"Janmashtami at Dwarkadhish Temple","note":"A major pilgrimage celebration on Gujarat's coast."}]

events.hook: A temporary city of 70,000 people, art cars and giant installations appears in the Nevada desert and burns away.
events.overview: For nine days Black Rock City becomes a gift-economy experiment, with huge art, themed camps, all-night dance floors and desert sunrises. It ends with the burning of the Man and then the Temple. It demands preparation, because you need to bring everything you need to survive in the desert.
events.costNotes: Housing covers the ticket, camp gear or RV rental and supplies; flight is to Reno, and dates follow the usual Labor Day schedule.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"San Francisco, USA","event":"Outside Lands (early Aug)","note":"A big music and food festival in Golden Gate Park."},{"destination":"Sturgis, South Dakota, USA","event":"Sturgis Motorcycle Rally (early Aug)","note":"A huge biker gathering with Black Hills riding."}]

events.hook: Europe's biggest street party: soca, steel pan and sound systems for two million people.
events.overview: Over the August bank holiday weekend, west London fills with Caribbean floats, costumed dancers, jerk smoke and thumping sound systems. Sunday is the family day and Monday is the main parade. It is one of the best free events in the world.
events.costNotes: London mid-range rentals are pricey in late August, and the bank holiday adds to rates.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Toronto, Canada","event":"Toronto Caribbean Carnival (Caribana, early Aug)","note":"A big Caribbean parade on the lakefront, a short flight from LAX."},{"destination":"Bridgetown, Barbados","event":"Crop Over Grand Kadooment (Aug 2)","note":"The finale of a harvest festival, with costumed bands and soca all day."}]

events.hook: Slip into the water beside mother humpbacks and their calves.
events.overview: Humpbacks come to Tonga's warm waters to breed and calve, and Vava'u is one of the few places where licensed operators let you swim with them. September is peak season, with calves very active. It is a remote, intimate marine encounter with few crowds.
events.costNotes: Flights usually connect via Auckland or Fiji, and activities assume about four whale-swim tours.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Hervey Bay, Australia","event":"Humpback whale watching season","note":"Calm, shallow bay with reliable boat-based sightings."},{"destination":"Samaná, Dominican Republic","event":"Humpback season (starts later)","note":"A Caribbean whale destination, but its season runs mostly January to March."}]

events.hook: Red carpets on the Lido, with the lagoon as the backdrop.
events.overview: One of the world's oldest film festivals takes over the Lido each year, with world premieres and early Oscar buzz. Public screenings and the late-summer lagoon light make it worth the trip even without a badge. The 2027 dates are estimated from the usual late-August to early-September pattern.
events.costNotes: Festival week pushes Venice lodging well above normal rates.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Toronto, Canada","event":"Toronto International Film Festival","note":"A big, audience-friendly film festival in the same early-to-mid September window."},{"destination":"Lake Como, Italy","event":"Late-summer lake season","note":"A quieter, romantic alternative that is only a short train ride from Venice's crowds."}]

events.hook: Ten days of drums, giant elephant-god idols and a sea of devotees at the final immersion.
events.overview: Mumbai's biggest festival fills the city with towering Ganesh pandals, processions and street food. It ends with Anant Chaturdashi, when thousands of idols are carried to Girgaum Chowpatty and the sea. It is loud, devotional and chaotic in the best way.
events.costNotes: India is cheap on the ground, but flights from LAX are long and costly.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Pune, India","event":"Ganeshotsav","note":"The festival's historic home, with a more traditional feel and fewer crowds than Mumbai."},{"destination":"Hyderabad, India","event":"Khairatabad Ganesh and Hussain Sagar immersion","note":"Home to one of India's tallest idols and a huge lakeside immersion."}]

events.event: Fiestas de Santa Fe and Burning of Zozobra
events.hook: A 50-foot marionette called Old Man Gloom goes up in flames, and the city celebrates for days.
events.overview: The Fiestas, held since 1712, combine a historic procession, mariachi and the Zozobra burning, where thousands shout away their worries. It is a local tradition more than a tourist production. The dates are estimated from the usual Labor Day weekend schedule.
events.costNotes: Santa Fe lodging is pricey, and flights usually connect via Albuquerque or Phoenix.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Albuquerque, United States","event":"Pre-Balloon Fiesta season and Old Town events","note":"The Balloon Fiesta follows in early October if you can delay the trip."},{"destination":"Taos, United States","event":"Taos Pueblo events and autumn aspens","note":"Quieter mountain town with Native American heritage and early color."}]

events.event: Mid-Autumn Festival and Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance
events.hook: A 70-meter dragon of burning incense winds through the streets under the full moon.
events.overview: Hong Kong celebrates the full moon with lantern displays at Victoria Park, mooncakes and the Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance. The dance, a recognized intangible cultural heritage, runs for three nights. Add the city's food scene and the harbor and you have a strong autumn trip.
events.costNotes: Hotel-sized rooms rather than Airbnb are common, so housing is priced higher.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Taipei, Taiwan","event":"Mid-Autumn moon festival","note":"Neighborhood barbecues and lantern displays make this the locals' favorite holiday."},{"destination":"Hanoi, Vietnam","event":"Tet Trung Thu lantern festival","note":"Lantern-filled Old Quarter streets and children's parades."}]

events.hook: Hundreds of thousands pack the Zócalo for the midnight shout of independence.
events.overview: On the night of September 15 the president rings the bell from the National Palace and leads El Grito. The night brings fireworks, mariachi and a lot of street food. A military parade follows on the 16th, and the city is decorated in green, white and red.
events.costNotes: A short, cheap flight, and CDMX is excellent value for the money.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Guanajuato, Mexico","event":"Grito de Dolores celebrations","note":"Celebrations in a colorful colonial city close to where the independence movement began."},{"destination":"Oaxaca, Mexico","event":"Independence Day and Guelaguetza-style regional culture","note":"Regional food, mezcal and a smaller, more intimate Independence celebration."}]

events.hook: Wooden festival floats weighing tons race around street corners at full speed.
events.overview: Teams of hundreds pull ornate danjiri carts through Kishiwada's streets, tearing around sharp corners in the famous yarimawashi. The festival is a thrilling, locals-first spectacle close to Osaka and not widely known abroad. The dates are estimated from its usual third-weekend-of-September schedule.
events.costNotes: Base yourself in Osaka, since Kishiwada has limited lodging.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kyoto, Japan","event":"Autumn temple season and Tsukimi moon-viewing","note":"Moon-viewing events at temples such as Daikaku-ji."},{"destination":"Takayama, Japan","event":"Hachiman Matsuri (autumn festival)","note":"Takes place in October, so it works best if you extend the trip."}]

events.hook: The world's biggest beer festival, with lederhosen, brass bands and liter steins.
events.overview: Over six million visitors fill the Theresienwiese for Bavarian beer, roast chicken and oompah. Tents open at 9 a.m. on weekdays, and the opening parade and tapping are an event of their own. Go midweek for an easier time finding a table.
events.costNotes: Lodging prices spike during the festival, and beer-tent spending adds up.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Stuttgart, Germany","event":"Cannstatter Volksfest","note":"A second-biggest-in-Germany beer festival with a more local crowd."},{"destination":"Salzburg, Austria","event":"Autumn Almabtrieb and Rupertikirtag season","note":"Alpine traditions and cattle drives in a gorgeous setting."}]

events.hook: Human towers, fire-breathing dragons and free concerts across the city.
events.overview: Barcelona's patron saint festival has castells (human towers), giants and correfoc fire runs, plus hundreds of free concerts and fireworks. It is a strong way to see Catalan culture at full volume. The dates are estimated from the usual September 24 feast-day timing.
events.costNotes: Prices are moderate for a major European city in early autumn.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"San Sebastián, Spain","event":"San Sebastián Film Festival and pintxos season","note":"A film festival and top food scene at the same time of year."},{"destination":"Logroño, Spain","event":"San Mateo and Rioja grape harvest festival","note":"Wine-focused harvest celebrations, with grape treading and bullfighting-free events in La Rioja."}]

events.hook: A palace lit by about 100,000 bulbs, royal processions and caparisoned elephants.
events.overview: Mysuru's Dasara is a ten-day state festival of music, dance, wrestling and royal ritual that ends with the Jumbo Savari procession on Vijayadashami. The Mysore Palace is lit up in the evenings, and the city turns into a living museum of Karnataka's culture. Exact dates follow the lunar calendar, so confirm closer to the date.
events.costNotes: Low on-the-ground costs, with the flight to Bengaluru the main expense.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kolkata, India","event":"Durga Puja pandal tours","note":"The same Navaratri season with a very different, art-heavy celebration."},{"destination":"Kullu, India","event":"Kullu Dussehra","note":"A week-long Himalayan festival of village deities after Vijayadashami."}]

events.hook: Rugby's biggest tournament lands in Australia for the first time since 2003, in the Southern Hemisphere spring.
events.overview: The men's Rugby World Cup runs across eight Australian host cities, with the final in Sydney on Nov 13. Pool matches fill October with packed fan zones, pub atmosphere and a chance to pair games with Sydney Harbour and the beaches. Tickets and Sydney accommodation will sell out early.
events.costNotes: Peak-demand accommodation pricing and match tickets drive the total up.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Perth, Australia","event":"Rugby World Cup pool matches","note":"Hosts early tournament games and has quieter beaches and wine country nearby."},{"destination":"Brisbane, Australia","event":"Rugby World Cup pool matches","note":"Warm, subtropical host city with easy access to the Gold Coast."}]

events.hook: Hundreds of hot-air balloons lift off together at dawn over the high desert.
events.overview: The world's largest hot-air balloon gathering fills the sky with 500+ balloons, and includes mass ascensions, the Dawn Patrol, and glowing evening balloon glows. It's an easy trip from LAX and one of the most photographed events in North America. Weekends are the biggest, with the mass ascensions on Saturday and Sunday mornings.
events.costNotes: Fiesta-week lodging is at a premium, and a road trip would cut the flight cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Santa Fe, USA","event":"Fall colors and Fiestas season in northern New Mexico","note":"A calm base an hour from the Fiesta field, with art and green chile in season."},{"destination":"Cappadocia, Turkey","event":"Daily balloon flights over fairy chimneys","note":"Year-round balloon spectacle with an autumn-friendly climate."}]

events.hook: Millions of Oromo gather at Lake Hora to give thanks for the end of the rainy season.
events.overview: Irreecha is the Oromo people's thanksgiving celebration, held beside the crater lake of Hora Arsadi near Bishoftu. Crowds in traditional dress carry grass and flowers, sing and bless the water in one of Africa's largest cultural gatherings. It's a rare, deeply local event; plan carefully and follow local guidance, since crowd and security conditions vary.
events.costNotes: Cheap on the ground, with long-haul fares through Addis Ababa the main cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Lalibela, Ethiopia","event":"Orthodox highland churches and post-Meskel celebrations","note":"Rock-hewn churches and highland culture after the rains."},{"destination":"Masai Mara, Kenya","event":"Wildebeest river crossings in the closing weeks","note":"Late-season herds are still on the Mara's plains."}]

events.event: International White Truffle Fair of Alba
events.hook: The world's most prized fungus takes over a Piedmont wine town during vineyard harvest season.
events.overview: Alba's truffle fair has a market with tastings, truffle auctions, cooking shows and hunts with trained dogs in the Langhe hills. October also brings the Barolo and Barbaresco harvest, so the whole region is lively. Weekends are busiest and a car helps you reach the villages.
events.costNotes: Truffle-heavy meals and wine tastings push the food and activity costs up.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"San Miniato, Italy","event":"White truffle festival in Tuscany","note":"Held in November, so better as a later add-on than for the same dates."},{"destination":"Istria, Croatia","event":"Truffle season and autumn harvest festivals","note":"Cheaper truffle hunts with coastal scenery."}]

events.hook: Gilded floats and puppet shows roll through an Edo-era mountain town in peak autumn color.
events.overview: One of Japan's three most beautiful festivals, Takayama's autumn event brings out ornate yatai floats, mechanical karakuri puppets and a lantern-lit night procession through the old town. The fall foliage in the Japanese Alps is at its best at the same time. Hotels book out months ahead, so reserve early.
events.costNotes: Festival-weekend lodging is steep, and the 12 days could include Kyoto and Tokyo.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Nagoya, Japan","event":"Gateway city for Alps and autumn leaf trips","note":"Cheaper hotels and quick rail to Takayama and Shirakawa-go."},{"destination":"Gwangju, South Korea","event":"Autumn mountain foliage and regional food festivals","note":"Similar autumn scenery with lower costs."}]

events.hook: Latin America's premier arts festival fills a colorful colonial city with music, theatre and dance.
events.overview: The Cervantino brings international orchestras, dance companies and theatre troupes to the stages, plazas and callejones of Guanajuato. The UNESCO-listed city is a backdrop of painted houses and underground tunnels, and many shows are free outdoors. The programme is usually announced a few months in advance.
events.costNotes: Fly into Leon (BJX) or Mexico City, with moderate festival-season lodging.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"San Miguel de Allende, Mexico","event":"Early autumn fiestas and Day of the Dead preparations","note":"Close by and good for combining with Guanajuato."},{"destination":"Morelia, Mexico","event":"Morelia International Film Festival","note":"A colonial city with an October film festival."}]

events.hook: The Pink City glows with lamps, fireworks and shopping-bazaar mayhem.
events.overview: Diwali is India's biggest festival. In Jaipur the old city's markets are lit with lights, homes are covered in diyas and rangoli, and families gather for sweets and fireworks on the main night, expected around Oct 29. Lunar-calendar dates can shift by a day, so confirm the main day closer to travel.
events.costNotes: Flights and rooms spike around Diwali, though local costs stay low.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Varanasi, India","event":"Diwali and ghats lit with lamps","note":"The riverfront glows, with the larger Dev Deepawali coming in November."},{"destination":"Singapore","event":"Deepavali in Little India","note":"A lighter-touch celebration with street lights and food stalls."}]

events.hook: Cemetery vigils, sand tapestries and marigold-lined streets in Mexico's cultural capital.
events.overview: Oaxaca's Day of the Dead builds across several days with elaborate altars, comparsas (costumed parades), candlelit cemetery visits and markets selling pan de muerto and mezcal. It is both celebratory and solemn, and visitors are welcome if they are respectful. Book far ahead because Oaxaca fills up fast.
events.costNotes: Lodging is most expensive over Oct 30 - Nov 2.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Pátzcuaro, Mexico","event":"Janitzio Night of the Dead","note":"A more traditional lake-island vigil, but crowded on the main nights."},{"destination":"Mexico City, Mexico","event":"Day of the Dead parade and altars","note":"Larger-scale city celebrations with museums and a big parade."}]

events.hook: A walled city stages Europe's biggest Halloween carnival, with fireworks over the River Foyle.
events.overview: Derry claims the birthplace of Halloween traditions, and it throws a multi-day festival with a costume parade, street theatre, music and a riverside fireworks finale. The Celtic Samhain roots feel real in the walled city. It makes a good base for the Causeway Coast and Donegal.
events.costNotes: Festival-weekend rooms are pricey, and flights usually go via Dublin or London.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Dublin, Ireland","event":"Bram Stoker Festival","note":"Halloween-weekend literary and gothic events in the capital."},{"destination":"Edinburgh, Scotland","event":"Samhuinn Fire Festival and Halloween events","note":"Celtic-themed fire celebrations in a historic city."}]
